name: Nancy Pelosi

summary: Nancy Pelosi has represented San Francisco in the House since 1987 and was the first woman to serve as speaker (2007–2011, 2019–2023), overseeing both impeachments of Donald Trump. She announced in November 2025 that she would not seek reelection, and has made promoting Gavin Newsom for 2028 one of her causes.
